standard_prerequisites.name: The structure of injective modules over a Noetherian ring as direct sums of injective hulls of residue fields
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1028-1031 and attributed to a proposition of another chapter (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the zeroth local cohomology of an injective module and shows that it is again injective.

standard_prerequisites.name: The spectral sequence of a composite functor in the form available for complexes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1043-1047 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the unit of the adjunction is an isomorphism on bounded below complexes with support, given that only the q = 0 terms survive.

core_obligations: Injections with support: for a module supported in T the proof chooses an embedding into an injective module, decomposes that injective into a direct sum of injective hulls of residue fields, and computes the zeroth local cohomology of each hull according to whether its prime lies in T (proof lines 1027-1036)

Injective resolutions with support: the resulting module is injective and receives the original module, so every module supported in T has an injective resolution whose terms also have support in T, whence the functor is the identity on these modules (proof lines 1036-1040)

Descend to complexes: for a bounded below complex with support in T the proof uses the spectral sequence of the composite functor, whose q = 0 column is everything, to see that the canonical map from the derived functor to the identity is an isomorphism (proof lines 1042-1049)
Conclude: the functor is fully faithful and essentially surjective, with quasi-inverse given by the derived zeroth local cohomology (proof lines 1049-1051)
proof_roadmap: 对 Mod_{A,T} 中的模 M 嵌入内射模 J；由跨章命题 J 是剩余域内射包之直和，而每个内射包 E 满足 H^0_T(E) = 0（素数不在 T）或 E（素数在 T），故 H^0_T(J) 仍内射且含 M，于是 M 有各项都在 Mod_{A,T} 的内射分解，RH^0_T(M) = M。
对 K ∈ D^+_T(A) 用谱序列 R^qH^0_T(H^p(K)) ⇒ R^{p+q}H^0_T(K)：由上一段只有 q = 0 项非零，故 RH^0_T(K) → K 是同构，遂得等价，拟逆为 RH^0_T。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the bounded below derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset with the full subcategory of the bounded below derived category of all modules consisting of the complexes supported there (author lemma at source lines 1019-1024, label lemma-equal-plus). The proof (source lines 1026-1052) first proves that every module with support in T admits an injective resolution whose terms again have support in T, which rests on the structure of injective modules over a Noetherian ring and on the explicit computation of the zeroth local cohomology of an injective hull (proof lines 1027-1040), and then uses the spectral sequence of the composite functor to deduce that the derived zeroth local cohomology is an isomorphism on the whole bounded below subcategory (proof lines 1042-1051). The injective-resolution step is the content. H2.
